title: Click and collect
description: A Desk board for web orders a store must pick and hand over. A report lists the web orders still to pick (submitted sales orders still to deliver that carry a web order number). On Delivery Note, two fields that can be set after the note is submitted: Handed over (a list column and a list filter: the Delivery Note list filtered on Status To Bill or Completed, Is Return No, % Returned less than 100, Handed over No, Customer's Purchase Order No set, your store's warehouse and Date on or after the install day is the list of orders waiting for their customer) and Collected by (the name of who took it); the delivery note's history records who ticked it and when. A workspace, Click and collect, opens the sales orders and the delivery notes and says how to find the report and the waiting list. A manifest only: nothing leaves the shop.

custom_fields.label: Handed over
custom_fields.description: Tick when the customer (or the carrier) has taken the order. The delivery note's history records who ticked it and when.

custom_fields.label: Collected by
custom_fields.description: The name of the person who took the order, as on their ID.

reports.name: PP CCB Web Orders To Pick

data.text: To pick: search Desk for Web orders to pick, then make each order's delivery note. Still to collect: open Delivery notes and filter Status To Bill or Completed, Is Return No, % Returned less than 100, Handed over No, Customer's Purchase Order No set, your warehouse and Date on or after the install day; save that filter.
